name: claude-code-extension-engineering
description: Architecture decision reference for Claude Code extensions: which mechanism should own a behavior, why the nearest alternative is wrong, and what the choice actually guarantees. Selection guide, 18 composition cards, 30 hook-event contracts plus changelog-only deltas, dated version gates, and a machine-checked evidence ledger. Benchmarked: 44 percent unaided versus 100 percent with the reference, methodology published.
